Auto arrange third-party software

Viz.js 3.31.0 (MIT), copyright Michael Daines.
https://github.com/mdaines/viz-js/tree/c8ce050d28eb0dc1ed1629ea32ab7f3dc117db0f
This unmodified browser bundle contains Graphviz 16.1.0 (EPL-2.0) and
Expat 2.8.5 (MIT). Corresponding source is available at:
https://gitlab.com/api/v4/projects/4207231/packages/generic/graphviz-releases/16.1.0/graphviz-16.1.0.tar.gz
https://github.com/libexpat/libexpat/releases/download/R_2_8_5/expat-2.8.5.tar.gz
Build recipe for the embedded object code:
https://github.com/mdaines/viz-js/blob/c8ce050d28eb0dc1ed1629ea32ab7f3dc117db0f/packages/viz/backend/Dockerfile

WebCola 3.4.0 (MIT), copyright Tim Dwyer and contributors.
https://github.com/tgdwyer/WebCola

The following license texts apply to these components. They are embedded in
all distributed workbenches with the worker payload. No layout engines are
included in standalone viewers, native viewers or the backend runtime.
